TaskBrief, EvidenceBundle, EvalContract and ImpactPreview provide generic PostgreSQL authority, immutable revisions, exact refs and receipt-first mutations

findings.finding: CustomerLite exists, but no canonical SegmentRevision, JourneyRevision, DialogueBrief, DialogueEvidenceSelection, DialogueEvalPack, DialogueStrategyRevision, TouchpointObservation or RecommendationDraft contract, PostgreSQL store, service or API exists in the current Workshop branch.

ecommerce.customer declares required object and generic capability names, but viewRefs, productionContractRefs, responsibilityTemplateRefs, impactCalculatorRefs and actionTypes are empty; only one dry-run eval asset is referenced and no exact customer production contract is bound.

no tenant-scoped Consent or Preference authority, purpose and marking decision, retention decision, channel eligibility snapshot, revocation version or exact policy refs were found; client-side hiding cannot authorize segmentation or outreach preparation.

the runtime source adapter explicitly drops eight ns_member PII fields and CustomerLite tests describe a PII-minimized object, while p08-customer-lite.yaml still lists nickname, mobile, email, realName and address fields as mappings and carries a different exclusion list. The canonical projection and asset manifest are therefore not a single reviewable privacy contract.

no immutable segment definition, query hash, cutoff, consent-policy ref, membership-query revision, k-anonymity decision, exclusion reason or rebuild receipt exists; legacy decision tags and widget filters are not SegmentRevision authority.
no versioned Journey definition, stage transition policy, entry and exit criteria, schedule and capacity refs, eligibility evaluator, invalidation semantics or human review authority was found.
no typed DialogueBrief, evidence selection, independent Eval binding, strategy revision, protected contact-resolution boundary or aggregation policy with original message refs exists.

no side-effect-free customer dialogue Batch prepare/freeze state machine, immutable target ref set, per-target consent and frequency eligibility, exclusion reasons, strategy and Eval exact refs, version CAS, zero-send invariant or prepare Receipt exists.

the customer route currently renders only the common installed-module shell; no consent-safe segment builder, journey version Diff, dialogue evidence and Eval disclosure, batch preflight or small-cohort aggregation view is implemented.

the focused CustomerLite and P08 suite is not GREEN: 27 tests passed and 6 failed. Four failures attempt the unavailable localhost:13306 path because the legacy pymysql mocks no longer intercept JdbcConnectorRuntime; two fail because old sample-input tests conflict with the current live-execution fail-closed rule. W6-07 cannot claim a stable customer foundation until tests and current connector behavior are reconciled without weakening live safety.

the broader 51-test foundation run produced 50 passes and one failure because the dev-org/dev-project canary retained two ResponsibilityPlan rows while the API test assumes an empty shared tenant. No rows were deleted; the fixture must isolate or explicitly seed its own state before this result can be treated as a clean regression gate.
W4-08 and W6-01 remain unchecked; exact Evidence integration and assignee/capability readiness therefore cannot authorize W6-07 implementation or completion.
